elaine: Heads up — hitting noisy warnings + flakes in pytest when running tests with uvloop + our Python SDK.

elaine: Repro: simple async test that uses the SDK client from sync helper:
```py
# tests/conftest.py
def make_client():
    return sdk.Client(api_key=.. )  # sync constructor but internally spins up background tasks

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_it(make_client):
    client = make_client()
    await client.generate(...)
    # no explicit close in test
```

elaine: Fails intermittently with:
```
RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'AsyncClient.aclose' was never awaited
  Task was destroyed but it is pending!
RuntimeError: Event loop is closed
```

rishi: That looks like our sync Client starting an asyncio task in the background and relying on __del__ to shutdown. Under pytest's event loop teardown (and uvloop) that races badly.

yao: Also noticed typing annoyances when switching to explicit AsyncClient. IDEs still pick the sync Client type and autocompletion is wrong. Might need proper overloads: def Client(...)->SyncClient and async def AsyncClient(...)->AsyncClient or factory funcs.

tom: Quick answers: 1) library should never call asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete inside __init__ or __del__; 2) provide an explicit AsyncClient class with __aenter__/__aexit__ and a sync-safe close() that uses anyio.from_thread.run to call aclose; 3) emit a RuntimeWarning in __del__ that instructs callers to close explicitly (don't schedule tasks).

elaine: I pushed a tiny gist with CI log: https://gist.github.com/elaine/ef12ab34 — shows failing test and stack trace. CI job: ci-bot: test-async/uvloop failed on branch fix/async-close (see https://ci.example.com/67890)

rishi: For DX we should also add docs to quickstart: example showing both sync usage (sync client that proxies to hosted API without background loop) and an explicit AsyncClient example.

yao: On the typing side I can propose overloads in typeshed-style and a mypy plugin note. Also add AsyncClient to __all__ and update README snippets to prefer `async with AsyncClient() as c:`.

tom: Can we add a lint rule in pre-commit that rejects creating Client() at module import time? That pattern triggers background tasks during test collection and is painful.

elaine: Workaround for now in tests: use fixture to construct and await close in teardown:
```py
@pytest.fixture
async def async_client():
    async with sdk.AsyncClient() as c:
        yield c
```

rishi: I'll draft PR: separate AsyncClient, deprecate starting background loop in sync Client, add anyio.from_thread.close_sync(), add typing overloads and docs. Will include uvloop CI job.

ci-bot: CI job `test-async/uvloop` failed on branch fix/async-close 5d check logs: https://ci.example.com/67890/log

elaine: Thanks — please tag me for review. I'll help validate under our flaky uvloop matrix.

yao: Filed ticket DEX-432: Provide explicit AsyncClient + safe close + typing fixes.

rishi: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2201 (WIP). Will ping for review once tests pass. :thumbsup:
